basis: The full-period river temperature change from 2005 to 2014 is calculated as the difference between the 2014 endpoint value (10.1°C) and the 2005 endpoint value (23.9°C), resulting in a decrease of 13.8°C. This is a substantial decrease, and the routing decision must be based on whether this magnitude meets the program's substantial-change criterion.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 river temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
